title: A question card: pools/<pool>/<id>-<slug>.md, after lowering. pool comes from the folder.

id.description: The card id, which evidence refers to.

pool.description: The folder name. Not written in the file.

title.description: The question as the pager and the run of show name it.

minutes.description: How long the question takes, for the pick.

tier.description: Pick order inside a pool: core cards are offered first (ADR 004).

competencies.description: Default competencies for Look for bullets that carry no #tag.

overlaps.description: Card ids that cover the same ground. The pick never puts two of them in one interview.

review.description: needs-check flags a card whose wording waits for sign-off.

reviewMd.description: What changed, for the dev review form. Never in a build.

lookFor.description: Observables under "### <level>" headings, with optional #competency tags and nested Nudge:, Show it: and Fallback: lines.

stretch.description: Prompts under "### <level>" headings. Each reads Ask this at its level and above.
